label: For "Intraday Liquidity Forecasting": Forecast intraday payment inflows and outflows by settlement system so treasury funds positions on time without holding excess buffers. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Training on end-of-day aggregated data hides timing.
